name: TC-308: a chain member's Menu tab shows the location banner, split summary and per-item source chips
description: Location A's Menu tab: header 'Managing: A • part of your chain' + 'Switch to chain view (2 locations)'; banner 'You're editing A. Shared items come from the chain menu…'; summary 'N shared (chain) · N only this location'; the shared item is chipped 'From shared menu' and has $ + carry icons, the local item is chipped 'This location only' and has neither. The builder's scope bar reads 'Editing menu for:' with 'Switch to all 2 locations' → the chain shell Menu tab.

steps.name: Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /^Add or edit items$|^Open the builder for .* only|^Manage the shared chain menu/ })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to chain view \(\d+ locations\)/ })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/You're editing .*Shared items come from the chain menu/)
Expect "toContainText" getByText(/You're editing .*Shared items come from the chain menu/)
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/\d+ shared \(chain\) · \d+ only this location/)
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-source-chip').filter({ hasText: 'From shared menu' }).or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByText('From shared menu', { exact: true })).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-price-override').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Using shared price|Location price)/ })).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-carry-toggle').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 4a69a402' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Remove from this location's menu|Add back to this location's menu)/ })).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-source-chip').filter({ hasText: 'This location only' }).or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByText('This location only', { exact: true })).first()

Expect "toHaveCount" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-price-override').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Using shared price|Location price)/ })).first()

Expect "toHaveCount" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByTestId('menu-carry-toggle').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 4a69a402 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Local 4a69a402' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Remove from this location's menu|Add back to this location's menu)/ })).first()
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiPaper-root').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Automation Menu 4a69a402', exact: true }) }).last().getByText(/Shared · all \d+ locations/)
Click getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to all \d+ locations/ }).or(getByRole('link', { name: /Switch to all \d+ locations/ }))
